description: This source file provides utilities for handling, validating, and normalizing database URLs specifically for PostgreSQL with asyncpg and SQLAlchemy. It includes data classes, validation functions, and URL manipulation functions tailored for database connection configuration and validation.

classes.name: NormalizedDatabaseConfig
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the normalized database URL and connection arguments for SQLAlchemy asyncpg connections.

methods.name: str|None _extract_hostname(url: str)
methods.description: Extracts the hostname from a database URL, returning None if it cannot be parsed.

methods.name: bool _looks_like_bad_hostname(hostname: str)
methods.description: Heuristic to identify invalid hostname patterns such as URLs pasted into the hostname field.

methods.name: None validate_database_url_for_runtime(raw_url: str, *, dns_preflight: bool = True)
methods.description: Validates a database URL for correct format and DNS resolution, raising errors if invalid.

methods.name: str _normalize_scheme_to_asyncpg(url: str)
methods.description: Normalizes database URL schemes to the 'postgresql+asyncpg' format.

methods.name: Optional[str] _pop_query_param( query_params: MutableMapping[str, str], key: str )
methods.description: Removes and returns a query parameter from a URL's query string in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: NormalizedDatabaseConfig normalize_asyncpg_database_url(raw_url: str)
methods.description: Main function that validates, normalizes, and strips unsupported query parameters from a database URL, returning a normalized config object.
